audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own explanations. Levels 2 and 3 were given to Ornn while whys[1] and whys[2] say Kennen stuns him and owns the wave; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were 'Skill' while whys[3] says he reclaims the commit window and whys[4] calls 6 your biggest spike; first item was Ornn while whys[5] ends 'so it's even'.
audit.why: 46.9% over 290 games: Kennen wins the pre-Brittle levels and the ult window, Ornn owns 4-5 once Searing Charge is up and everything from two items. The packet chart matches this reading row for row.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2 Kennen, L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Ornn, L6 Kennen, first item Skill, 2+ items Ornn.

audit.why: Spikes sit correctly at 2-3, 6 and first item for Kennen, late for Ornn. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s while Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100, so Kennen out-cycles the ult trade until rank 2-3 — consistent with 6 and first item being his and the late being Ornn's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early block calls Ornn's last-hitting tool 'W (Volcanic Rumble)'. There is no such ability: Volcanic Rupture is his Q, and W is Bellows Breath. The interrupt threat is also stated without its cooldown, which is what makes it trackable.
audit.why: Riot names and numbers: Q Volcanic Rupture, 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, slow plus a magma pillar; E Searing Charge, 450 range, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, knocks up on terrain collision; R Call of the Forge God, 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: He farms with Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9s); the knockup that cancels your channel is Searing Charge on a 14s cooldown at rank 1, which is long enough to trade around.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) into his own pillar knocks you up and cancels the commit, so chip from 950 and take no melee stretch.

edits.before: His level-3 E pillar knockup cancels your E-in and channel, so he reclaims the hard-commit window while you chip and respect.
edits.after: Searing Charge into his own pillar knocks you up and cancels your channel, and at 14s he holds it for every commit you make.

edits.before: Ornn is short-range and has no sustain, so abuse it: chip with Q (Thundering Shuriken) and let Electrical Surge autos add up while he tries to last-hit with W (Volcanic Rumble). At levels 2-3 a Q plus W-on-hit can stack three marks and stun him before his Brittle setup exists — that is your cleanest punish. The catch: he can pop W (Bellows Breath) to become CC-immune and shielded, so bait that bubble before you commit your mark chain, and respect that he's tankier than the squishies you usually bully.
edits.after: Ornn is short-range and has no sustain, so abuse it: chip with Q (Thundering Shuriken) and let Electrical Surge autos add up while he last-hits with Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9s). edits.after: Punish his 800 range with Q poke and Electrical Surge autos while he farms with his Q

notes: Left in place and flagged rather than edited: the current text asserts Bellows Breath grants CC-immunity and a shield. Riot's description in the kit says only that Ornn advances breathing fire and applies Brittle — no immunity, no shield — so that claim is unverifiable from the data and I did not restate, strengthen or remove it. phases[5].rating stays 5/10, which already fits an even stage, so only the side/win pair is proposed for that row.
